name: abdominal stretch
interpretation: Original low prone press-up with planted ventral pelvis and relaxed legs, flat open palms, extended finger pads and natural bent elbows. A low preparatory chest clearance avoids forcing the original neutral cage through the floor. The hips never rise; this is not an upward-dog transition. Trunk extension is distributed across spine segments and the head remains relaxed near forward gaze at the hold. The 5-second demonstration compresses a source 20–30-second hold.

source_roles.illustrative_palette: cyan stretch, neutral inactive skin; not measured recruitment

provenance: Repository instruction text and unchanged Blender Studio CC0 mannequin. No restricted exercise images/video used.

staging.laterality: Bilateral symmetrical press-up; no alternating side.
staging.support: Ventral pelvis, anterior thigh/knee/shin, foot dorsum, palm heel and all distal finger pads on shared z=0 illustration floor.
staging.hands: Open palm down, fingers forward, mild natural spread; thumb abducted to the floor.
staging.elbow_poles: Backward with small lateral offset; no elbow lock.
staging.neck: Head pitch 65 degrees downward at low entry, 17 degrees at hold; no extreme backward neck tilt.
staging.timing: 2 seconds enter, 1 second hold, 2 seconds return. Workout hold remains separate.

joint_targets.basis: Blender-world rotations about +X applied to original rest segments; 0 upright, 90 prone. These are authored segment orientations, not validated anatomical joint limits.

native_surface: Original native JointSurfaceCorrective and Multires retained; independent QA compares against exported original cage with linear skinning.
